description: This Java class 'WebDaemon' provides functionality to start the OpenMRS server in a new thread within a web context. It handles exceptions related to database updates and input requirements and uses a daemon task execution framework.

classes.name: WebDaemon
classes.description: A utility class providing a method to start OpenMRS in a separate daemon thread within a web application context.

methods.name: startOpenmrs
methods.description: Starts the OpenMRS server in a new thread, with exception handling for database updates and input requirements, using the daemon task framework.
